Single-stage versus double-stage laryngotracheal reconstruction for grade III subglottic stenosis in children: a multicenter cohort

Ana Silva, Bruno Souza, Carla Costa, Pediatric Airway Group

Abstract

Background

The best strategy for grade III subglottic stenosis is debated.

Methods

Retrospective cohort of 84 children (2015-2024) across 3 centers.

Results

Decannulation was achieved in 88% after single-stage and 91% after double-stage reconstruction (p=0.62).

Conclusions

Single-stage reconstruction had similar decannulation with shorter stay.
